cardSettlements.note: For each day: the channel's collections in posted shifts, and whether the bank has paid them. Recording a settlement from the bank advice (net deposit + fee and its VAT) clears the station's channel receivable with an entry; anything the bank didn't pay stays visible in the receivable.

stationTanks.reconNote: Expected = opening reading + received − sold in approved/posted shifts. Variance = actual reading − expected (negative = loss). Tolerances come from the company settings.
stationTanks.unassignedNozzles: {{count}} nozzles aren't linked to a tank, so their sales aren't reconciled.
stationTanks.nozzleMapNote: Each nozzle draws from a tank at the same station with the same fuel. Its sales are deducted from that tank in the reconciliation.
stationTanks.receivedNote: Actually received = the tank dip after the drop minus the dip before it (plus anything sold during the drop).
stationTanks.postVarianceNote: Creates an entry valued at liters × the fuel item's current average cost: a shortage debits the tank variance account and credits stock, a gain does the reverse, plus a stock adjustment of the same liters in the station warehouse. After posting, the period's readings can't be voided and no delivery can be recorded inside it unless the posting is reversed.
stationTanks.postingsNote: Reverse the latest posting first for each tank. Reversing creates a reversal entry and removes the stock adjustment.
stationTanks.noPostings: No variances posted in this period.

stationSetup.digitsHelp: Meter digits = the number of digits before the decimal point on the cumulative litre meter (e.g. 999999.99 = 6 digits). landing.title: Athar Accounting
landing.heroSub: A complete cloud accounting system for managing your whole business group — from journal entries and ZATCA-compliant tax invoices, to inventory, fixed assets, HR and payroll — all in one place, in an interface designed from the ground up for your market.
landing.heroCtaTrial: Try free for a full month

about.title: About Athar Accounting
about.text: Athar Accounting is a cloud accounting system built specifically for the Arab business environment, aimed at simplifying day-to-day accounting work for business owners and accountants alike. The system is designed to cover the full workflow of any business or group of companies: from the accounting foundation (chart of accounts and daily journal entries), through sales, purchases, inventory and fixed assets, to managing employees, their payroll and entitlements. With full support for ZATCA-compliant e-invoicing for Saudi companies, and accurate financial reports that reflect the true picture of business performance at any moment, in each company's own currency and country.

why.title: Designed to fit the way you work

items.title: ZATCA compliant (Saudi companies)
items.desc: Electronic tax invoices (standard and simplified) with a real QR code, built from the ground up to meet the requirements of the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority — enabled automatically for any company that selects Saudi Arabia as its country.

items.title: A whole group in one place
items.desc: Manage all your companies from a single screen, with complete data separation per company and consolidated reports for the whole group.

items.title: A complete employee lifecycle
items.desc: From hiring and leave to payroll and end-of-service benefits, calculated automatically per the applicable labor system.

items.title: Instant financial reports
items.desc: The trial balance, income statement and balance sheet update live with every entry and invoice you record.

items.title: Integrated sales and purchases cycle
items.desc: From quotation to invoice to receipt, and from purchase order to supplier invoice, with full automatic accounting links.

items.title: An interface designed for your market
items.desc: Built from scratch to fit how accountants in the Arab market actually work, not an interface translated from a foreign system.

return.title: VAT return draft
return.note: From the documents posted in the period, by the tax category on each line. Exports and reverse-charge imports are not distinguished: all zero-rated amounts are on one line. Review before filing on the authority's portal.

archive.title: ZATCA document archive (Annex 1)
archive.note: XML files for the documents ZATCA accepted in the period — the ZATCA-cleared copy for standard invoices, our signed copy for simplified — named {VAT}_{date}T{time}_{number}.xml, with a manifest.csv listing every accepted document, including those sent before archiving began that have no stored original.
archive.result: Exported {{archived}} archived documents. Accepted documents with no stored original: {{missing}} (listed in manifest.csv).

items.otherSources: Manual, imported or other-source entries touching the account
items.documentEntryOutsidePeriod: Documents in the period whose entry is not in the period movement
items.entryForDocumentOutsidePeriod: Entries in the period for documents outside it
items.amountMismatch: Documents whose entry amount differs from their VAT

reason.entry_without_vat_line: Entry in the period but does not touch this account

recon.residualWarning: The residual is not zero: a difference remains that no item above explains. Do not sign the return before checking it.

outside.title: Missing from both sides (not in the difference)
